fieldNotes.dropArea: 112 + 62 = 174 marked trailer stalls per spec - band 50+. Dedicated drop yards alongside the buildings.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Building 1 has dock canopies on both its north and south faces (cross-dock layout) - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.truckGate: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE / INFERRED. No road-level Street View exists for this remote desert site and no exterior gate structure is clearly resolvable in satellite imagery. fieldNotes.remoteGs: true / inferred - assuming a truck gate with no guard booth (modern kiosk/app check-in). Flagged uncertain.
